messages:
elaine: FYI nightly hetero-gpu warmup red on linux-hetero-07. Failing during model warmup with OOM + kernel driver messages. CI link: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/3490012234 :grimacing:
ci-bot: [automated] job 3490012234 -> FAILED on node linux-hetero-07. Summary: warmup step hit 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY' and dmesg shows kernel XID/timeout lines. Full log excerpt below.
ci-bot: ```
2026-03-15T02:41:12Z warmup: allocating kv-cache...
2026-03-15T02:41:12Z cuda: malloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-15T02:41:12Z nvml: ECC corrected error count increase
[ 1432.123456] NVRM: GPU 0000:af:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 31: Ch 00000003, pid=8421, name=python, ctx=000000002, reason=E: L2 cache error
```
elaine: Can someone check if the driver rollout hit that node? We were doing a staged driver bump yesterday.
matt: Looks like the usual suspect. Node metadata says driver 535.86 on that host; canary pool rolled 535.95 last night. Might be a flip. Any chance the node has mixed images?
anya: I can check node tags. Also can you paste the GPU plugin logs? If it's a mixed driver/runtime mismatch we might see `CUDA runtime version mismatch` in the container logs.
jun: Quick triage plan: (1) requeue the job pinned to previous driver image, (2) if rerun fails, request a bisect across driver versions for that host image, (3) capture minimal repro snapshot. Sound OK?
elaine: yep. I don't want a full bisect unless it repros. First rerun pinned to known-good driver 535.86.
anya: Node shows image label `gpu-runtime:v2026-03-14-535.86` on linux-hetero-07. But the kube-daemonset on that host is running plugin `nvidia-driver:535.95`. So it's mixed.
matt: that mismatch explains it. Might be that daemonset updated but node image not drained. We should reprovision or force a rollback for that host. Jun, can you kick a rerun pinned to `gpu-runtime:v2026-03-14-535.86`?
jun: Doing rerun with tag. Command: `ci retry 3490012234 --node-label image=gpu-runtime:v2026-03-14-535.86 --reason "pin driver repro"`
ops-bot: Requeue request accepted. New run created: 3490012345 (linked to original 3490012234).
ci-bot: [automated] queued run 3490012345 on linux-hetero-07 with node image gpu-runtime:v2026-03-14-535.86.
elaine: Thanks. If that passes we can assume driver skew caused the false positive. If it fails again, matt will start a bisect.
matt: I'll kick off a narrow bisect if 3490012345 flakes. Also opening a short incident to track host remediation.
anya: I'll cordon linux-hetero-07 and schedule a safe repro reimage after the rerun finishes.
jun: quick tip — if anyone sees `nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates: NVML_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED` that often pairs with mixed kernel/driver versions.
elaine: Good call. I'll follow up with infra to validate daemonset rollout policy so we don't get mixed states.
matt: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1324 "hetero-07 driver skew causing warmup OOMs". Assignee: infra-oncall.
elaine: closing loop here once rerun completes. Thanks all.
